title: Operations workspace / 协作管理
brief: Desktop bilingual operations workspace: dense tables, status comparison and short row actions. Prioritize scanning over decoration.
manualChecks: Scan status and numeric columns without mistaking row actions for the primary action.
Open a row detail, close by Escape and verify focus returns.

title: Learning library / 学习内容
brief: Desktop bilingual course library for self-paced reading. Show progress, content cards and a clear continuation action, with comfortable spacing.
manualChecks: Read long English course titles and compare card progress.
Ensure softer primary fill still contrasts sufficiently in both themes.

title: Creative portfolio / 创意作品
brief: Desktop bilingual creative portfolio: visual expression, editorial storytelling and a featured project. Use gradient frost only where legibility stays stable.
manualChecks: Check the feature composition without a dashboard sidebar.
Compare actual glass and opaque fallback; inspect prominent outline action in dark mode.

title: Deployment console / 开发控制台
brief: Desktop bilingual developer console: deployment table, code, duration and service status. Compact operations layout; a monospaced code area distinct from interface text.
manualChecks: Check code and duration typography in dark mode.
Verify service status remains readable without relying only on hue.
